canonical_evaluator_asymmetry.mkf: the canonical coverage evaluator's format_relevant_chunk_from_validated keeps every candidate with non-empty text, regardless of validation
canonical_evaluator_asymmetry.mr: the canonical memory-recall evaluator's load_pw_from_rcv keeps only validation==1 candidates
canonical_evaluator_asymmetry.released_schema: every candidate ships once, tagged by `validation`; the evaluator's two renderers apply their own filter

corrections.note: these candidates ship with their original source_id and recorded text unchanged; the coordinate is uncertain but the text is not
corrections.shift: +1 sentence, adopted only when the shifted coordinate resolves to the recorded text exactly

design_rule: Publish exactly the strings the canonical evaluators read from validated[].sentence and salient[].sentences; never re-derive text from a coordinate.

gap_denominator.note: format_gap_cases's own literal filter (any row with non-empty validated) would include 2 more rows whose target_sentence is empty; this release keeps one gap set across MR, MKF, and v1 rather than a third, MKF-only population
gap_denominator.rule: target_sentence non-empty, matching release.sanitize_annotations and the v1 index

gap_reason_policy.released: the reasoning text only; leading [model_name] tags are stripped
gap_reason_policy.source: concatenation of per-model rationales in the RCV field

segmentation.evidence_coordinates: emoji removal then nltk punkt, per turn, one-based
segmentation.purpose: verifies a source_id correction only; never used to derive shipped text
